product.description: Zog e cel mai silitor dragon din școală, dar este și cel mai predispus la accidente: se izbește de copac în zbor, își pierde vocea când învață să ragă, ba chiar își arde aripa cu flăcările pe care le scoate pe nări. Va primi oare vreodată o steluță de aur?   Povestea lui Zog, scrisă în versuri și ilustrată de Axel Scheffler, a câștigat Galaxy National Children's Book of the Year în 2010.   „Fiul meu în vârstă de șase ani a fost fascinat.“ Evening Standard   Julia Donaldson este una dintre cele mai talentate și mai premiate autoare de cărți pentru copii din lume. Cunoscută și apreciată pentru creațiile sale în versuri, dar și pentru piesele de teatru și scenariile TV dedicate copiilor, Julia Donaldson a scris peste 60 de cărți, printre care se numără și volumele cu Gruffalo, traduse în peste 40 de limbi.

# Zog: The Award-Winning Dragon Adventure by Julia Donaldson & Axel Scheffler

Dive into the whimsical world of **Zog**, the beloved character in this award-winning children's book. More than just a story, *Zog* is an enchanting tale written in verse and beautifully illustrated by Axel Scheffler, following the life of the most powerful yet accident-prone dragon in school. Perfect for young readers who enjoy imaginative stories and rhyming verses, this volume brings joy and laughter to every corner of childhood reading time.

## About Zog: A Story of Flying Adventures

Zog is described as the strongest dragon in the classroomâa creature full of untamed energy! However, his immense power often leads to hilarious mishaps. From bumping into trees while flying to losing his voice when trying to roar, and even burning his wing with the fiery breath from his nostrils, Zogâs daily life is a delightful mix of adventure and accidental comedy.

The story asks a wonderful question: Will Zog ever receive a golden star? Through rhyming verses that children adore, *Zog* explores themes of self-acceptance, managing powerful emotions, and finding your place in the world.

## Written by Julia Donaldson, Illustrated by Axel Scheffler

This book carries the stamp of literary excellence. The story of Zog was recognized for its quality when it won the prestigious **Galaxy National Children's Book of the Year award in 2010**.

Julia Donaldson is one of the most acclaimed and talented authors of children's literature globally. Known for her masterful use of rhythm, rhyme, and engaging narratives, she has penned over 60 books. Her worksâincluding the volumes featuring Gruffalo (translated into over 40 languages)âare celebrated not only as picture books but also as stage plays and TV scripts. Reading *Zog* is an opportunity to introduce children to the magic of a literary giant whose creative flair resonates with audiences worldwide, from curious youngsters to fascinated adults.
